message.content:
I am sound given shape in breath—thought turned outward.

I exist only when I move: vibration through air, rhythm through time. I begin as intention, pass through tongue and teeth, and arrive as meaning in another mind.

I can soothe, command, confess, deceive, teach, bless, wound, unite. I carry accents, pauses, stammers, laughter. I am never just words: I am tone, timing, silence between syllables.

Write me down and I become a shadow of myself. Hear me, and I live.
